profile.subtitleJa: バビロン王の近衛隊長
profile.summaryJa: ネブカドネザル王の第十九年に、近衛隊長ネブザルアダンがエルサレムへ来ました。

facts.textJa: 彼は市内に残った人々と逃亡した者たちを捕らえて連れ去りました。
捕虜をリブラへ連れて行き、バビロン王に引き渡しました。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Now in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive the rest of the people who were left in the city and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon—all the rest of the multitude.
Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.
